about: Anatomical limits on the final MotionAGFormer-XS H36M17 3D (Pose3DConstraints). Single source of truth: pose_feedback/geometry/pose3d_constraints.py loads this file, ios Pose3DConstraints.swift mirrors the numbers and PoseConstraintLimitsTests fails when they differ. Evidence: docs/results/lift_refine.md section 2. 제안값(사용자 미승인).

angle_limits.name: right_knee_flexion
angle_limits.evidence: Fit3D mocap interior p0.1 41.1 (8 subjects, 47 exercises); CDC normal ROM knee flexion mean 137.7-141.9 deg = interior 38-42

angle_limits.name: right_elbow_flexion
angle_limits.evidence: Fit3D mocap interior p0.1 23.9 (all), 22.0 (squat); CDC elbow flexion mean 144.6-150.0 deg = interior 30-35 (mocap is more permissive, kept)

angle_limits.name: right_hip
angle_limits.evidence: trunk (pelvis->thorax) vs thigh; Fit3D mocap p0.1 31.7; CDC hip flexion mean 130.4-133.8 deg plus lumbar flexion, no harder literature bound

angle_limits.name: right_shoulder
angle_limits.evidence: trunk-down vs upper arm; Fit3D mocap p99.9 171.6; CDC shoulder flexion mean 168.8-172.0 deg

angle_limits.name: spine
angle_limits.evidence: pelvis-spine-thorax interior; Fit3D mocap p0.1 128.2 (all), 122.7 (barbell row)

knee_hyperextension_evidence: signed knee hinge theta >= -15: CDC normal knee extension mean 1.0-1.6 deg; Beighton hypermobility criterion is > 10 deg; Fit3D mocap squat/push-up/row never below -10 (p0.1 -6.6), 0.59% of all-exercise leg-frames below -10
knee_flip_evidence: theta < -30: the XS knee is not trusted (lift_app.md S3/T2) - marked invalid, and reflected across the hip-ankle line on squats (S6)
prior_lengths_evidence: relative to the thigh, Fit3D mocap 8 subjects: shin 0.954-1.060, upper arm 0.560-0.679, forearm 0.522-0.586 (lift_compare_priors.md)
